finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite atlas for Dream Town. Match existing cozy painterly isometric town art: creamy plaster, terracotta roofs, dark oak, jewel green foliage, soft sunlight from upper left, polished hand painted 3D illustration, crisp readable silhouettes. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 sprites in strict row-major order. Equal sized cells, each subject centered, at least 15 percent empty padding on EVERY side inside every cell. No sprite crosses its cell. Row 1: copper mine with reddish copper veins; silver mine with bright silver veins; gold mine with yellow gold veins; platinum mine with pale blue-white veins. Make four entrances visibly different. Row 2: copper ore chunk; silver ore chunk; gold ore chunk; platinum ore chunk with bluish crystals. Row 3: miner pickaxe; cartoon red dynamite bundle with unlit fuse and wooden detonator, no text; treasure chest with gems; ancient ceramic amphora and old bronze relic. Genuinely transparent alpha background and gutters. No checkerboard, solid background, captions, typography, watermarks or grid lines. No extra sprites. Whole subjects, no clipping. Buildings on small individual isometric grass/stone foundations. Aim for 2048px wide high quality sheet.
